headline: World Series heads back to Dubai for 2027
standfirst: The Dubai Darts Masters returns in January after a gap of nearly a decade, with a new home at the Coca Cola Arena.
body: Dubai is back on the World Series map. The PDC has confirmed the Dubai Darts Masters will take place on January 22-23, 2027, bringing the sand, the sunshine and a very different kind of crowd to the opening weeks of the year.

The city has history with the series. The original event ran from 2013 to 2017, and Gary Anderson won the last two editions. This time the darts move to the Coca Cola Arena, a proper indoor arena rather than the old Tennis Centre setting.
PDC Chief Executive Matt Porter said the city has a great history with the series and that the arena is a brilliant setting for two days of top-class darts.
The line-up has not been announced yet, and neither has the rest of the event information. Both are promised in due course.

It lands in a busy January. The Bahrain Darts Masters at The Dome in Manama is scheduled for January 14-15, so the Gulf is shaping up as a regular winter stop. Our view: a second Middle East date makes the early-season calendar look a lot more like a proper tour, and the players who like to travel light will be glad of it.
